name: Villalbilla de Burgos (Spain)
description: Square flag of three vertical stripes of green, red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villalbilla de Burgos (a castle, stars, a scroll and a bridge).
history: Municipal flag of Villalbilla de Burgos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villalbilla de Burgos arms — castle, stars, scroll and bridge
